family.name: IptcCore
family.label: IPTC Core Schema
family.description:
The IPTC Photo Metadata Standard is the most widely used standard to describe photos, because of its universal acceptance among news agencies, photographers, photo agencies, libraries, museums, and other related industries. It structures and defines metadata properties that allow users to add precise and reliable data about images.
Today, the IPTC Photo Metadata Standard consists of two schemas – IPTC Core and IPTC Extension – which were built on the legacy of the original IPTC-IIM, and developed by the IPTC for professional use with a focus on news and stock photos. IPTC worked alongside Adobe on the technical implementation of the metadata that employs Adobe’s XMP technology (now an ISO Standard) as an enriched alternative to the IIM format.
IPTC Core and IPTC Extension define metadata properties with comprehensive sets of fields that allow users to add precise and reliable data about people, locations, and products shown in an image. It also supports dates, names and identifiers regarding the creation of the photo, and a flexible way to express rights information.

tag.name: AltTextAccessibility
tag.label: Alt Text (Accessibility)
tag.description:
Enter text describing the appearance of the image from a visual perspective, focusing on details that are relevant to the purpose and meaning of the image
This property should not be confused with the IPTC property Headline, which is a brief synopsis or summary of the contents of the image. This property is required for conformance with the W3C Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG).

tag.name: City
tag.label: City (Deprecated)
tag.description:
Enter the name of the city pictured in this image.
This is a detail of a location with blurred semantics as it does not clearly indicate whether it is the location in the image or the location the photo was taken - which can be different. Two more concise properties are available in IPTC Extension with "Location Created" and "Location Shown in the Image".

tag.name: rights
tag.label: Copyright Notice
tag.description: Enter a Notice on the current owner of the Copyright for this image, such as ©2008 Jane Doe. Copyright ownership can be expressed in a more controlled way using the PLUS fields "Copyright Owner", "Copyright Owner ID", "Copyright Owner Name" of the IPTC Extension. It is the user's responsibility to keep the values of the four fields in sync. Dublin Core description Information about rights held in and over the resource. Typically, rights information includes a statement about various property rights associated with the resource, including intellectual property rights. Recommended practice is to refer to a rights statement with a URI. If this is not possible or feasible, a literal entry (name, label, or short text) may be provided.

tag.name: Country
tag.label: Country (Deprecated)
tag.description:
Enter the name of the country pictured in this image.
This is a detail of a location with blurred semantics as it does not clearly indicate whether it is the location in the image or the location the photo was taken - which can be different. Two more concise properties are available in IPTC Extension with "Location Created" and "Location Shown in the Image".

tag.name: CountryCode
tag.label: ISO Country Code (Deprecated)
tag.description:
Enter the 2 or 3 letter ISO 3166 Country Code of the Country pictured in this image.
This is a detail of a location with blurred semantics as it does not clearly indicate whether it is the location in the image or the location the photo was taken - which can be different. Two more concise properties are available in IPTC Extension with Location Created and Location Shown in the Image.

tag.name: creator
tag.label: Creator
tag.description: Enter the name of the person that created this image. The creator can be expressed in a more controlled way using the "Image Creator" of PLUS in the IPTC Extension additionally. It is the user's responsibility to keep the values of the IPTC Core and the PLUS fields in sync. Dublin Core description An entity responsible for making the resource. Recommended practice is to identify the creator with a URI. If this is not possible or feasible, a literal entry that identifies the creator may be provided.

tag.name: CreatorAddress
tag.label: Contact Info Address
tag.description:
Enter Address for the person that created this image.
The IPTC Extension Licensor fields should be used instead of these Creator's Contact Info fields if you are using IPTC Extension fields. If the creator is also the licensor his or her contact information should be provided in the Licensor fields.

tag.name: CreatorCity
tag.label: Contact Info City
tag.description:
Enter the City for the address of the person that created this image.
The IPTC Extension Licensor fields should be used instead of these Creator's Contact Info fields if you are using IPTC Extension fields. If the creator is also the licensor his or her contact information should be provided in the Licensor fields.

tag.name: CreatorCountry
tag.label: Contact Info Country
tag.description:
Enter the Country name for the address of the person that created this image
The IPTC Extension Licensor fields should be used instead of these Creator's Contact Info fields if you are using IPTC Extension fields. If the creator is also the licensor his or her contact information should be provided in the Licensor fields.

tag.name: CreatorWorkEmail
tag.label: Contact Info Email(s)
tag.description:
Enter the work Email address(es) for the person that created this image, such as name@domain.com.
The IPTC Extension Licensor fields should be used instead of these Creator's Contact Info fields if you are using IPTC Extension fields. If the creator is also the licensor his or her contact information should be provided in the Licensor fields.
Multiple email addresses can be given. May have to be separated by a comma in the user interface.

tag.name: CreatorWorkTelephone
tag.label: Contact Info Phone(s)
tag.description:
Enter the work Phone number(s) for the person that created this image, using the international format, such as +1 (123) 456789
The IPTC Extension Licensor fields should be used instead of these Creator's Contact Info fields if you are using IPTC Extension fields. If the creator is also the licensor his or her contact information should be provided in the Licensor fields.
Multiple numbers can be given. May have to be separated by a comma in the user interface.

tag.name: CreatorPostalCode
tag.label: Contact Info Postal Code
tag.description:
Enter the Postal Code for the address of the person that created this image.
The IPTC Extension Licensor fields should be used instead of these Creator's Contact Info fields if you are using IPTC Extension fields. If the creator is also the licensor his or her contact information should be provided in the Licensor fields.

tag.name: CreatorRegion
tag.label: Contact Info State/Province
tag.description:
Enter the State for the address of the person that created this image
The IPTC Extension Licensor fields should be used instead of these Creator's Contact Info fields if you are using IPTC Extension fields. If the creator is also the licensor his or her contact information should be provided in the Licensor fields.

tag.name: CreatorWorkURL
tag.label: Contact Info Web URL(s)
tag.description:
Enter the work Web URL(s) for the person that created this image, such as http://www.domain.com/
The IPTC Extension Licensor fields should be used instead of these Creator's Contact Info fields if you are using IPTC Extension fields. If the creator is also the licensor his or her contact information should be provided in the Licensor fields.
Multiple URL can be given. May have to be separated by a comma in the user interface.

tag.name: AuthorsPosition
tag.label: Creator's Jobtitle
tag.description: Enter the Job Title of the person listed in the Creator field

tag.name: Credit
tag.label: Credit Line
tag.description:
Enter who should be credited when this image is published.
Note 1: For more formal identifications of the creator or the owner of the copyrights of this image other rights properties may be used.
Note 2: This property was named "Credit" by the IIM metadata, then it was renamed to "Provider" in IPTC Core 1.0. In IPTC Core 1.1. it has been renamed to "Credit Line" as the field is used for this purpose by many users.

tag.name: DateCreated
tag.label: Date Created
tag.description: Enter the Date the image was taken

tag.name: description
tag.label: Caption/Description
tag.description: Enter a "caption" describing the who, what, and why of what is happening in this image, this might include names of people, and/or their role in the action that is taking place within the image Dublin Core description An account of the resource. Description may include but is not limited to: an abstract, a table of contents, a graphical representation, or a free-text account of the resource.

tag.name: CaptionWriter
tag.label: Caption/Description writer
tag.description:
Enter the name of the person(s) involved in writing, editing or correcting the Description, Alt Text (Accessibility), or Extended Description (Accessibility) of the image, separated by commas
Multiple description writers can be given. May have to be separated by a comma in the user interface.

tag.name: ExtDescrAccessibility
tag.label: Extended Description (Accessibility)
tag.description:
Enter the text describing the appearance of an image from a visual perspective, focusing on relevant details that further describe the meaning and purpose of the image
This property should not be confused with the IPTC property Description/Caption, which is the who, what, when, where, why, how of an image. This property can be combined with Alt Text (Accessibility) if and when a brief description is not sufficient to convey the purpose and meaning of an image. It should not repeat the information in the Alt Text (Accessibility) property. It is required for conformance with the W3C Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG).

tag.name: Headline
tag.label: Headline
tag.description: Enter a brief publishable synopsis or summary of the contents of the image

tag.name: Instructions
tag.label: Instructions
tag.description:
Enter information about embargoes, or other restrictions not covered by the Rights Usage field The Instructions may include any of the following:
  • embargoes (NewsMagazines OUT) and other restrictions not covered by the "Rights Usage Terms" field;
  • information regarding the original means of capture (scanning notes, colourspace info) or other specific text information that the user may need for accurate reproduction;
  • additional permissions required when publishing;
  • credits for publishing if they exceed the IIM length of the credit field

tag.name: IntellectualGenre
tag.label: Intellectual genre
tag.description:
Enter a term to describe the nature of the image in terms of its intellectual or journalistic characteristics.
Note on "legacy": the Intellectual Genre can be expressed in a more controlled way using the "Genre" property of the IPTC Extension, IPTC recommends using it.

tag.name: TransmissionReference
tag.label: Job Identifier
tag.description: Enter a number or identifier needed for workflow control or tracking

tag.name: subject
tag.label: Keywords
tag.description: Enter any number of keywords, terms or phrases to express the subject and other aspects of the content of the image. Dublin Core description A topic of the resource. Recommended practice is to refer to the subject with a URI. If this is not possible or feasible, a literal entry that identifies the subject may be provided. Both should preferably refer to a subject in a controlled vocabulary.

tag.name: State
tag.label: Province/State (Deprecated)
tag.description:
Enter the name of the province or state pictured in this image
This is a detail of a location with blurred semantics as it does not clearly indicate whether it is the location in the image or the location the photo was taken - which can be different. Two more concise properties are available in IPTC Extension with "Location Created" and "Location Shown in the Image".

tag.name: UsageTerms
tag.label: Rights Usage Terms (XMPRights)
tag.description:
Enter instructions on how this image can legally be used
Rights and licensing related properties of the IPTC Extension can be used in parallel to express the licensed usage in more controlled terms.

tag.name: Scene
tag.label: IPTC Scene Code
tag.description: Enter only the 6-digit codes from the IPTC Scene NewsCodes Controlled Vocabulary (see: http://cv.iptc.org/newscodes/scene)

examples.example: headshot : A head only view of a person (or animal/s) or persons as in a montage.
half-length : A torso and head view of a person or persons.
full-length : A view from head to toe of a person or persons
profile : A view of a person from the side
rear view : A view of a person or persons from the rear.
single : A view of only one person, object or animal.
couple : A view of two people who are in a personal relationship, for example engaged, married or in a romantic partnership.
two : A view of two people
group : A view of more than two people
general view : An overall view of the subject and its surrounds
panoramic view : A panoramic or wide angle view of a subject and its surrounds
aerial view : A view taken from above
under-water : A photo taken under water
night scene : A photo taken during darkness
satellite : A photo taken from a satellite in orbit
exterior view : A photo that shows the exterior of a building or other object
interior view : A scene or view of the interior of a building or other object
close-up : A view of, or part of a person/object taken at close range in order to emphasize detail or accentuate mood. Macro photography.
action : Subject in motion such as children jumping, horse running
performing : Subject or subjects on a stage performing to an audience
posing : Subject or subjects posing such as a "victory" pose or other stance that symbolizes leadership.
symbolic : A posed picture symbolizing an event - two rings for marriage
off-beat : An attractive, perhaps fun picture of everyday events - dog with sunglasses, people cooling off in the fountain
movie scene : Photos taken during the shooting of a movie or TV production.

tag.name: Source
tag.label: Source (Supply Chain)
tag.description: Enter or edit the name of a person or party who has a role in the content supply chain, such as a person or entity from whom you received this image from

tag.name: SubjectCode
tag.label: IPTC Subject Code (Deprecated)
tag.description: Enter only the 8-digit codes from the IPTC Subject NewsCode Controlled Vocabulary (see: http://cv.iptc.org/newscodes/subjectcode) Note on "legacy": The Subject Codes were retired by IPTC before 2010. For the classification of images use the IPTC Media Topics vocabulary now, see: http://cv.iptc.org/newscodes/mediatopic For the Media Topics the CV Term About Image property must be used.

tag.name: Location
tag.label: Sublocation (Deprecated)
tag.description:
Enter the name of the Sublocation pictured in this image
This is a detail of a location with blurred semantics as it does not clearly indicate whether it is the location in the image or the location the photo was taken - which can be different. Two more concise properties are available in IPTC Extension with "Location Created" and "Location Shown in the Image".

tag.name: title
tag.label: Title
tag.description: Enter a short verbal and human readable name for the image, this may be the file name Many use the Title field to store the filename of the image, though the field may be used in many ways. Formal identifiers are provided by the Digital Image Id, or the Registry Entry property of the IPTC Extension. Dublin Core description A name given to the resource.

family.name: IptcExt
family.label: IPTC Extension schema
family.description:
The IPTC Photo Metadata Standard is the most widely used standard to describe photos, because of its universal acceptance among news agencies, photographers, photo agencies, libraries, museums, and other related industries. It structures and defines metadata properties that allow users to add precise and reliable data about images.
Today, the IPTC Photo Metadata Standard consists of two schemas – IPTC Core and IPTC Extension – which were built on the legacy of the original IPTC-IIM, and developed by the IPTC for professional use with a focus on news and stock photos. IPTC worked alongside Adobe on the technical implementation of the metadata that employs Adobe’s XMP technology (now an ISO Standard) as an enriched alternative to the IIM format.
IPTC Core and IPTC Extension define metadata properties with comprehensive sets of fields that allow users to add precise and reliable data about people, locations, and products shown in an image. It also supports dates, names and identifiers regarding the creation of the photo, and a flexible way to express rights information.

tag.name: AdditionalModelInformation
tag.label: Additional model info
tag.description:
Enter information like ethnicity or other details about the model(s) in this image
Use the Model Age field for the age of model(s).

tag.name: OrganisationInImageCode
tag.label: Code of featured Organisation
tag.description:
Code from a controlled vocabulary for identifying the organisation or company which is featured in the image.
For example a stock ticker symbol may be used.

format.description: Enter an identifier for the controlled vocabulary, then a colon, and finally the code from the vocabulary assigned to the organisation shown in this image (e.g. nasdaq:companyA)

tag.name: OtherConstraints
tag.label: Constraint
tag.description: Constraints may limit the scope of usage allowed

tag.name: ContributorIdentifier
tag.label: Identifier
tag.description:
Enter person(s) or party/parties or organisation(s) having contributed to making the image. Enter globally unique identifier(s) of the entity or concept.
A distinction between contributor and creator should follow rights laws, contracts or common business rules.

tag.name: ContributorName
tag.label: Contributor Name
tag.description:
Enter person(s) or party/parties or organisation(s) having contributed to making the image. Enter the name of the entity or concept.
A distinction between contributor and creator should follow rights laws, contracts or common business rules.

tag.name: ContributorRole
tag.label: Role
tag.description: Enter person(s) or party/parties or organisation(s) having contributed to making the image. An added role helps to refine the kind of contribution. Enter an identifier for the role the entity has regarding the contributor property.

format.description: A vocabulary of roles of persons contributing to an image should be based on industry wide practices such as https://cv.iptc.org/newscodes/contentprodpartyrole/

examples.example: Author : A party (person, organisation or system) that created the content
Camera Operator : A party (person, organisation or system) who operates the camera that records the content of the item
Content Editor : A party (person, organisation or system) that edited the content of the item
Content Source : A party (person, organisation or system) that contributed to the content of the item as a source
Correspondent : A party (person, organisation or system) that is reporting information that contributes to the content of the item
Description Writer : A party (person, organisation or system) editing the description of content
Distributor : A party (person, organisation or system)that distributed an item
Editor : A party (person, organisation or system) editing the content and/or metadata of the item
Fact Checker : Specifies the party (person, organisation or system) that fact-checked the news item to ensure its accuracy
Generative AI Prompt Writer : A party (person, organisation, or system) that wrote or edited the prompt entered into a generative AI system
Image Supplier : A party (person, organisation or system) that supplied an image as content of the item
Interviewee : A person being interviewed for the item
Media Office : The media relationships office of a person, organisation or company
Metadata Editor : A party (person, organisation or system) that edited the metadata of the item
Content Originator : A party which orginated the content of the item
Information Originator : A party (person, organisation or systenm) which provided some information, such as metadata, used to create or enhance the content of the item
Producer : A party (person, organisation or system) that curates and manages the creation of content
Spokesperson : The spokesperson of a person, organisation or company

tag.name: CopyrightOwnerID
tag.description:
Enter the owner or owners of the copyright in the licensed image
Serves to identify the rights holder/s for the image. The Copyright Owner, Image Creator and Licensor may be the same or different entities.

tag.name: CopyrightOwnerName
tag.description:
Enter the owner or owners of the copyright in the licensed image
Serves to identify the rights holder/s for the image. The Copyright Owner, Image Creator and Licensor may be the same or different entities.

tag.name: AboutCvTermCvId
tag.label: About Vocabulary ID
tag.description:
Enter one or more topics, themes or entities the image is about, each one expressed by a term from a Controlled Vocabulary.
Enter the globally unique identifier of the Controlled Vocabulary which the term is from.

examples.example: The Media Topic NewsCodes has been IPTC's primary subject taxonomy since 2010, with a focus on classification of text.

tag.name: AboutCvTermId
tag.label: About Vocabulary Term ID
tag.description: Enter one or more topics, themes or entities the image is about, each one expressed by a term from a Controlled Vocabulary. Enter the globally unique identifier of the term from a Controlled Vocabulary.

format.description: URI For example: IPTC Media Topic NewsCodes.

tag.name: AboutCvTermName
tag.label: About Vocabulary Term Name
tag.description:
Enter one or more topics, themes or entities the image is about, each one expressed by a term from a Controlled Vocabulary.
Enter the name of the term from a Controlled Vocabulary as free-text.

tag.name: AboutCvTermRefinedAbout
tag.label: About Refined Aboutness
tag.description:
Enter one or more topics, themes or entities the image is about, each one expressed by a term from a Controlled Vocabulary. Optionally enter a refinement of the 'about' relationship of the term with the content of the image. This must be a globally unique identifier from a Controlled Vocabulary.
May be used to refine the generic about relationship.

tag.name: DataMining
tag.label: Data Mining
tag.description:
Regional laws applying to an asset may prohibit, constrain, or allow data mining for certain purposes (such as search indexing or research), and may overrule the value selected for this property. Similarly, the absence of a prohibition does not indicate that the asset owner grants permission for data mining or any other use of an asset.
The prohibition “Prohibited except for search engine indexing” only permits data mining by search engines available to the public to identify the URL for an asset and its associated data (for the purpose of assisting the public in navigating to the URL for the asset), and prohibits all other uses, such as AI/ML training.
The PLUS "Other Constraints" property is human readable. The IPTC properties "Embedded Encoded Rights Expression" and "Linked Encoded Rights Expression" are machine readable.

examples.example: Allowed
Prohibited
Prohibited for AI/ML training
Prohibited except for search engine indexing
Prohibited for Generative AI/ML training
Prohibited, see plus:OtherConstraints
Prohibited, see iptcExt:EmbdEncRightsExpr
Prohibited, see iptcExt:LinkedEncRightsExpr
Unspecified - no prohibition defined

tag.name: DigitalImageGUID
tag.label: Digital Image Identifier
tag.description:
If an ID already exists, don't change - otherwise enter a globally unique identifier for this digital image.
The identifier will probably be generated by the technical means of an imaging device or software and should be applied to the digital image file as early as possible in its life cycle. This identifier does not identify any pictured content, particularly in case of a scan of non-digital images, only this digital representation.

tag.name: DigitalSourceType
tag.label: Digital Source Type
tag.description: The type of the source of this digital image.

format.description: Select one of the values for identifying the type of the source of the digital image from the controlled vocabulary.

examples.example: Digital capture sampled from real life : The media was captured from a real-life source using a digital camera or digital recording device

Multi-frame computational capture sampled from real life : The media is the result of capturing multiple frames from a real-life source using a digital camera or digital recording device, then automatically merging them into a single frame using digital signal processing techniques and/or non-generative AI. Includes High Dynamic Range (HDR) processing common in smartphone camera apps.
Digitised from a transparent negative : The media was digitised from a negative on film or other transparent medium
Digitised from a transparent positive : The media was digitised from a positive on a transparency or other transparent medium
Digitised from a non-transparent medium : The media was digitised from a non-transparent medium such as a photographic print
Human-edited media : Augmentation, correction or enhancement by one or more humans using non-generative tools
Edited using Generative AI : Augmentation, correction or enhancement using a Generative AI model, such as with inpainting or outpainting operations

Algorithmically-altered media : Modification or correction by algorithm without changing the main content of the media, initiated or configured by a human, such as sharpening or applying noise reduction
Digital creation : Media created by a human using non-generative tools
Data-driven media : Digital media representation of data via human programming or creativity
Created using Generative AI : Digital media created algorithmically using an Artificial Intelligence model trained on captured content
Pure algorithmic media : Media created purely by an algorithm not based on any sampled training data, e.g. an image created by software using a mathematical formula
Screen capture : A capture of the contents of the screen of a computer or mobile device
Virtual event recording : Live recording of virtual event based on Generative AI and/or captured elements
Composite of elements : Mix or composite of several elements, any of which may or may not be generative AI
Composite of captured elements : Mix or composite of several elements that are all captures of real life
Composite including generative AI elements : Mix or composite of several elements, at least one of which is Generative AI

tag.name: EmbeddedEncodedRightsExpr
tag.label: Embedded Encoded Rights expression
tag.description: Shows an encoded rights expression. These values cannot be changed by metadata panels. Shows an embedded rights expression using a rights expression language which is encoded as a string.

tag.name: EmbeddedEncodedRightsExprType
tag.label: Embedded Encoded Rights expression Encoding type
tag.description: Shows an encoded rights expression. These values cannot be changed by metadata panels. Shows the encoding type of the rights expression by an IANA Media Type.

tag.name: EmbeddedEncodedRightsExprLangID
tag.label: Embedded Encoded Rights Expression Language ID
tag.description: Shows an encoded rights expression. These values cannot be changed by metadata panels. Shows the identifier of the used Rights Expression Language.

tag.name: EventID
tag.label: Event ID
tag.description:
Enter one or more identifiers of the event where this image was taken
The URL/URI of a persistent calendar showing this event can be used.

tag.name: Event
tag.label: Event Name
tag.description:
Enter the name or description of the event where this image was taken
Examples are: a press conference, dedication ceremony, etc. If this is a sub-event of a larger event both can be provided by the field: e.g. "XXXIII Olympic Summer Games (Paris): opening ceremony". Unplanned events could be named by this property too.

tag.name: GenreCvId
tag.label: Genre Vocabulary ID
tag.description: Enter the globally unique identifier of the Controlled Vocabulary which the term is from

tag.name: GenreCvTermId
tag.label: Genre Vocabulary Term ID
tag.description: Enter the globally unique identifier of the term from a Controlled Vocabulary

tag.name: GenreCvTermName
tag.label: Genre Vocabulary Term Name
tag.description: Enter the name of the term from a Controlled Vocabulary as free-text

tag.name: GenreCvTermRefinedAbout
tag.label: Genre Refined Aboutness
tag.description:
Optionally enter a refinement of the 'about' relationship of the term with the content of the image. This must be a globally unique identifier from a Controlled Vocabulary
May be used to refine the generic about relationship.

tag.name: ImageCreatorID
tag.description:
Enter details about the creator or creators of this image.
The creator can be additionally expressed in free-text using the IPTC Core Creator field. In many countries, the Image Creator must be attributed in association with any use of the image. The Image Creator, Copyright Owner, Image Supplier and Licensor may be the same or different entities.

tag.name: ImageCreatorName
tag.description:
Enter details about the creator or creators of this image
The creator can be additionally expressed in free-text using the IPTC Core Creator field. In many countries, the Image Creator must be attributed in association with any use of the image. The Image Creator, Copyright Owner, Image Supplier and Licensor may be the same or different entities.

format.description: real number; a value from 0 to 5, or -1 for "rejected"

tag.name: RegistryOrganisationID
tag.label: Registry Entry Organisation Identifier
tag.description:
An identifier for the registry which issued the corresponding Registry Image Id.
Enter the identifier for the registry which issued the corresponding Registry Image ID.

tag.name: RegistryItemID
tag.label: Registry Entry Item Identifier
tag.description:
A unique identifier created by a registry and applied by the creator of the digital image. This value shall not be changed after being applied. This identifier is linked to a corresponding Registry Organisation Identifier.
Enter IDs for this image and the registry issuing the image ID. Enter the unique identifier created by a registry and applied by the creator of the digital image.
Typically an id from a registry is negotiated and applied after the creation of the digital image. This identifier may be globally unique by itself, but it must be unique for the issuing registry at least.

tag.name: RegistryEntryRole
tag.label: Registry Entry Role
tag.description:
An identifier of the reason and/or purpose for this Registry Entry.
Enter an identifier of the role of this registry entry in the context of other entries.

tag.name: ImageSupplierID
tag.label: Image Supplier ID
tag.description:
Identifies the most recent supplier of the image, who is not necessarily its owner or creator.
For identifying the supplier either a well known and/or registered company name or a URL of the company's web site may be used. This property succeeds the Provider property of IPTC Core 1.0 by its semantics as that Provider was renamed to Credit Line.

format.description: Optional PLUS-ID identifying the Image Supplier. If the PLUS-ID being stored in this field is registered with the PLUS Coalition, it should be expressed as a URL. For example: https://plus-id.org/PLUS-ID.

tag.name: ImageSupplierName
tag.label: Image Supplier Name
tag.description:
Name of the most recent supplier of the image, who is not necessarily its owner or creator.
This property succeeds the Provider property of IPTC Core 1.0 by its semantics as that Provider was renamed to Credit Line.

tag.name: ImageSupplierImageID
tag.label: Image Supplier Image Id
tag.description: Identifier assigned by the Image Supplier to the image.

tag.name: LinkedEncodedRightsExpr
tag.label: Rights Expression Link
tag.description: The link to a rights expression using a rights expression language. Enter the link to a web resource representing an encoded rights expression.

tag.name: LinkedEncodedRightsExprType
tag.label: Rights Expression Encoding type
tag.description: The encoding type of the rights expression, identified by an IANA Media Type.

tag.name: LinkedEncRightsExprRightsExprLangId
tag.label: Rights Expression Language ID
tag.description: The identifer of the rights expression language used by the rights expression.

tag.name: MaxAvailHeight
tag.label: Maximum available height
tag.description: The maximum available height in pixels of the original photo from which this photo has been derived by downsizing.

tag.name: MaxAvailWidth
tag.label: Maximum available width
tag.description: The maximum available width in pixels of the original photo from which this photo has been derived by downsizing.

tag.name: MinorModelAgeDisclosure
tag.label: Minor Model Age Disclosure
tag.description:
Age of the youngest model pictured in the image, at the time that the image was made.
This age should not be displayed to the public on open web portals and the like. But it may be used by image repositories in a B2B enviroment.

examples.example: Age 14 or Under
Age 15
Age 16
Age 17
Age 18
Age 19
Age 20
Age 21
Age 22
Age 23
Age 24
Age 25 or Over
Age Unknown

tag.name: ModelAge
tag.label: Model age
tag.description:
Age of the human model(s) at the time this image was taken in a model released image.

family.label: IPTC Extension: Image Region
family.description:
The IPTC Photo Metadata Standard is the most widely used standard to describe photos, because of its universal acceptance among news agencies, photographers, photo agencies, libraries, museums, and other related industries. It structures and defines metadata properties that allow users to add precise and reliable data about images.
Today, the IPTC Photo Metadata Standard consists of two schemas – IPTC Core and IPTC Extension – which were built on the legacy of the original IPTC-IIM, and developed by the IPTC for professional use with a focus on news and stock photos. It also supports dates, names and identifiers regarding the creation of the photo, and a flexible way to express rights information.

tag.name: ImageRegionBoundaryShape
tag.label: Region Boundary Shape
tag.description: The shape of the boundary of a region inside an image. The value MUST be taken from the enumeration rectangle, circle, polygon.

examples.example:
a rectangle as shape of the boundary, the shape of a square is included.
Properties: the x- and y-axis coordinates of the upper left corner of the rectangle and the width and height of the rectangle relative to this upper left corner.

a circle as the shape of the boundary
Properties: the x- and y-axis coordinates of the centre of the circle and its radius measured along the x-axis.

any shape with edges, except a rectangle, including a single point (using 1 vertex) and a line (using 2 vertices). The edges between a vertex and the next one in the sequence set the shape, the last edge is the one from the last vertex in the sequence to the first vertex in the sequence.
Properties: the x- and y-axis coordinates of the vertex/the vertices of the polygon.

tag.name: ImageRegionBoundaryUnit
tag.label: Measuring Unit
tag.description: Unit used for measuring dimensions of the boundary of a region. The value MUST be taken from the enumeration pixel, relative.

examples.example: A pixel of a digital image setting an absolute value. In case of rescaling the image the coordinate values and the radius of a circle must be rescaled too.
Relative part of the size of an image along the x- or the y-axis. The range of the value is from 0 to 1 representing the proportion of the full size of an image along the x-axis or the y-axis.

tag.name: ImageRegionBoundaryX
tag.label: Region Boundary X-Axis Coordinate
tag.description:
Distance along the x-axis of the coordinate system related to its Point Zero. Used only by the shapes rectangle and circle. The coordinates of points used as reference of a shape of the region boundary and values defining the size of the shape are expressed by scalar values along the x-axis or the y-axis of a rectangular coordinates system. The rules for this system are:
  • Point Zero of the coordinates follows the Image Data Arrangement of the pixels of a digital image as defined by Exif (CIPA DC-008-2019):
    • The top row of the pixels is the first row, the leftmost pixel of a row is the first pixel.
    • The counting of “top row” and “leftmost” applies to pixel data as set when the pixels were (re-)organized by the camera or by software. The orientation (rotation, flipping) of the image defined by a metadata value MUST NOT be applied.
    • Point Zero of the coordinates is the first, leftmost pixel in the top row.
    • The x-axis is from Point Zero along the top row of the image. The range of coordinate values is from 0 to any positive value not exceeding the size of the image.
    • The y-axis is from Point Zero along the first pixels of the rows in the image. The range of coordinate values is from 0 to any positive value not exceeding the size of the image.
  • Coordinates of a point in the image MUST have an x-axis and a y-axis value.
  • Values defining the size of the shape are measured along the x-axis and the y-axis.
  • The unit of a value is defined by the Region Boundary Measuring Unit property, its value MUST be from the enumeration defined for the Boundary Measuring Unit property.

tag.name: ImageRegionBoundaryY
tag.label: Region Boundary Y-Axis Coordinate
tag.description:
Distance along the y-axis of the coordinate system related to its Point Zero. Used only by the shapes rectangle and circle. The coordinates of points used as reference of a shape of the region boundary and values defining the size of the shape are expressed by scalar values along the x-axis or the y-axis of a rectangular coordinates system. The rules for this system are:
  • Point Zero of the coordinates follows the Image Data Arrangement of the pixels of a digital image as defined by Exif (CIPA DC-008-2019):
    • The top row of the pixels is the first row, the leftmost pixel of a row is the first pixel.
    • The counting of “top row” and “leftmost” applies to pixel data as set when the pixels were (re-)organized by the camera or by software. The orientation (rotation, flipping) of the image defined by a metadata value MUST NOT be applied.
    • Point Zero of the coordinates is the first, leftmost pixel in the top row.
    • The x-axis is from Point Zero along the top row of the image. The range of coordinate values is from 0 to any positive value not exceeding the size of the image.
    • The y-axis is from Point Zero along the first pixels of the rows in the image. The range of coordinate values is from 0 to any positive value not exceeding the size of the image.
  • Coordinates of a point in the image MUST have an x-axis and a y-axis value.
  • Values defining the size of the shape are measured along the x-axis and the y-axis.
  • The unit of a value is defined by the Region Boundary Measuring Unit property, its value MUST be from the enumeration defined for the Boundary Measuring Unit property.

tag.name: ImageRegionBoundaryW
tag.label: Rectangle Width
tag.description: The size of a rectangular region boundary along the x-axis, its width. The range of a width value is any positive value not exceeding the size of the image along its x-axis. Used only by the shape rectangle.

tag.name: ImageRegionBoundaryH
tag.label: Region Boundary Rectangle Height
tag.description: The size of a rectangular region boundary along the y-axis, its height. The range of a height value is any positive value not exceeding the size of the image along its y-axis. Used only by the shape rectangle.

tag.name: ImageRegionBoundaryRx
tag.label: Region Boundary Circle Radius
tag.description: The radius of a circular region boundary from the centre of the circle measured along the x-axis. The range of a radius value is any positive value not exceeding the size of the image. Used only by the shape circle.

tag.name: ImageRegionBoundaryVerticesX
tag.label: Region Boundary Vertex X-Axis Coordinate
tag.description: Sequence of vertices of the polygon. Used only by the shape polygon. Distance along the x-axis of the coordinate system related to its Point Zero.

tag.name: ImageRegionBoundaryVerticesY
tag.label: Region Boundary Vertex Y-Axis Coordinate
tag.description: Sequence of vertices of the polygon. Used only by the shape polygon. Distance along the y-axis of the coordinate system related to its Point Zero

tag.name: LocationCreatedLocationId
tag.label: Location created ID
tag.description:
The location the photo was taken. Enter the details about a location where this image was created. Globally unique identifier of the location.
If the location in the image is different from the location the photo was taken the IPTC Extension property 'Location Shown in the Image' should be used.

tag.name: LocationCreatedLocationName
tag.label: Location created Name
tag.description:
The location the photo was taken. Enter the details about a location where this image was created. Full name of the location.
If the location in the image is different from the location the photo was taken the IPTC Extension property 'Location Shown in the Image' should be used.

tag.name: LocationCreatedSublocation
tag.label: Location created Sublocation
tag.description:
The location the photo was taken. Enter the details about a location where this image was created. Name of a sublocation. This sublocation name could either be the name of a sublocation to a city or the name of a well known location or (natural) monument outside a city. In the sense of a sublocation to a city this element is at the fifth level of a top-down geographical hierarchy.
If the location in the image is different from the location the photo was taken the IPTC Extension property 'Location Shown in the Image' should be used.

tag.name: LocationCreatedCity
tag.label: Location created City
tag.description:
The location the photo was taken. Enter the details about a location where this image was created. Name of the city of a location. This element is at the fourth level of a top-down geographical hierarchy.
If the location in the image is different from the location the photo was taken the IPTC Extension property 'Location Shown in the Image' should be used.

tag.name: LocationCreatedProvinceState
tag.label: Location created Province/State
tag.description:
The location the photo was taken. Enter the details about a location where this image was created. The name of a subregion of a country - a province or state - of a location. This element is at the third level of a top-down geographical hierarchy.
If the location in the image is different from the location the photo was taken the IPTC Extension property 'Location Shown in the Image' should be used.

tag.name: LocationCreatedCountryName
tag.label: Location created Country Name
tag.description:
The location the photo was taken. Enter the details about a location where this image was created. The name of a country of a location. This element is at the second level of a top-down geographical hierarchy.
If the location in the image is different from the location the photo was taken the IPTC Extension property 'Location Shown in the Image' should be used.

tag.name: LocationCreatedCountryCode
tag.label: Location created Country ISO-Code
tag.description:
The location the photo was taken. Enter the details about a location where this image was created. The ISO code of a country of a location. This element is at the second level of a top-down geographical hierarchy.
If the location in the image is different from the location the photo was taken the IPTC Extension property 'Location Shown in the Image' should be used.

format.description: Enter the 2 or 3 letter ISO 3166 Country Code of the Country.

tag.name: LocationCreatedWorldRegion
tag.label: Location created World Region
tag.description:
The location the photo was taken. Enter the details about a location where this image was created. The name of a world region of a location. This element is at the first (top) level of a top-down geographical hierarchy.
If the location in the image is different from the location the photo was taken the IPTC Extension property 'Location Shown in the Image' should be used.

tag.name: LocationCreatedGPSAltitude
tag.label: Location created GPS-Altitude
tag.description:
The location the photo was taken. Enter the details about a location where this image was created. Altitude in meters above or below the WGS84 reference level of this Location.
If the location in the image is different from the location the photo was taken the IPTC Extension property 'Location Shown in the Image' should be used.

tag.name: LocationCreatedGPSAltitudeRef
tag.label: Location created GPS-Altitude Ref
tag.description:
The location the photo was taken. Enter the details about a location where this image was created. The relationship of the GPS Altitude value to the reference level of WGS84: value 0 = above, 1 = below
The WGS84 reference level is the surface of the mathematical representation of the earth's globe. At a specific location this level may be a few metres above of below the Mean Sea Level of an ocean or a sea.
If the location in the image is different from the location the photo was taken the IPTC Extension property 'Location Shown in the Image' should be used.

examples.example: Above sea level
Below sea level

tag.name: LocationCreatedGPSLongitude
tag.label: Location created GPS-Longitude
tag.description:
The location the photo was taken. Enter the details about a location where this image was created. Longitude of a WGS84 based position of this Location.
If the location in the image is different from the location the photo was taken the IPTC Extension property 'Location Shown in the Image' should be used.

format.description: Be aware that the value of this property includes the degrees of the latitude and must indicate whether it is in the east or west.

tag.name: LocationCreatedGPSLatitude
tag.label: Location created GPS-Lattitude
tag.description:
The location the photo was taken. Enter the details about a location where this image was created. Latitude of a WGS84 based position of this Location.
If the location in the image is different from the location the photo was taken the IPTC Extension property 'Location Shown in the Image' should be used.

format.description: Be aware that the value of this property includes the degrees of the latitude and must indicate whether it is in the north or south.

tag.name: LocationShownLocationId
tag.label: Location shown ID
tag.description:
A location shown in the image. Globally unique identifier of the location.
If the location the image was taken in is different from this location the property 'Location Created' should be used too.

tag.name: LocationShownLocationName
tag.label: Location shown Name
tag.description:
A location shown in the image. Full name of the location.
If the location the image was taken in is different from this location the property 'Location Created' should be used too.

tag.name: LocationShownSublocation
tag.label: Location shown Sublocation
tag.description:
A location shown in the image. Name of a sublocation. This sublocation name could either be the name of a sublocation to a city or the name of a well known location or (natural) monument outside a city. In the sense of a sublocation to a city this element is at the fifth level of a top-down geographical hierarchy.
If the location the image was taken in is different from this location the property 'Location Created' should be used too.

tag.name: LocationShownCity
tag.label: Location shown City
tag.description:
A location shown in the image. Name of the city of a location. This element is at the fourth level of a top-down geographical hierarchy.
If the location the image was taken in is different from this location the property 'Location Created' should be used too.

tag.name: LocationShownProvinceState
tag.label: Location shown Province/State
tag.description:
A location shown in the image. The name of a subregion of a country - a province or state - of a location. This element is at the third level of a top-down geographical hierarchy.
If the location the image was taken in is different from this location the property 'Location Created' should be used too.

tag.name: LocationShownCountryName
tag.label: Location shown Country Name
tag.description:
A location shown in the image. The name of a country of a location. This element is at the second level of a top-down geographical hierarchy.
If the location the image was taken in is different from this location the property 'Location Created' should be used too.

tag.name: LocationShownCountryCode
tag.label: Location shown Country ISO-Code
tag.description:
A location shown in the image. The ISO code of a country of a location. This element is at the second level of a top-down geographical hierarchy.
If the location the image was taken in is different from this location the property 'Location Created' should be used too.

format.description: Enter the 2 or 3 letter ISO 3166 Country Code of the Country.

tag.name: LocationShownWorldRegion
tag.label: Location shown World Region
tag.description:
A location shown in the image. The name of a world region of a location. This element is at the first (top) level of a top-down geographical hierarchy.
If the location the image was taken in is different from this location the property 'Location Created' should be used too.

tag.name: LocationShownGPSAltitude
tag.label: Location shown GPS-Altitude
tag.description:
A location shown in the image. Altitude in meters above or below the WGS84 reference level of this Location.
If the location the image was taken in is different from this location the property 'Location Created' should be used too.

tag.name: LocationShownGPSAltitudeRef
tag.label: Location shown GPS-Altitude Ref
tag.description:
A location shown in the image. The relationship of the GPS Altitude value to the reference level of WGS84: value 0 = above, 1 = below
The WGS84 reference level is the surface of the mathematical representation of the earth's globe. At a specific location this level may be a few metres above of below the Mean Sea Level of an ocean or a sea.
If the location the image was taken in is different from this location the property 'Location Created' should be used too.. The WGS84 reference level is the surface of the mathematical representation of the earth's globe. At a specific location this level may be a few metres above of below the Mean Sea Level of an ocean or a sea.

examples.example: Above sea level
Below sea level

tag.name: LocationShownGPSLongitude
tag.label: Location shown GPS-Longitude
tag.description:
A location shown in the image. Longitude of a WGS84 based position of this Location.
If the location the image was taken in is different from this location the property 'Location Created' should be used too.

format.description: Be aware that the value of this property includes the degrees of the latitude and must indicate whether it is in the east or west.

tag.name: LocationShownGPSLatitude
tag.label: Location shown GPS-Lattitude
tag.description:
A location shown in the image. Latitude of a WGS84 based position of this Location.
If the location the image was taken in is different from this location the property 'Location Created' should be used too.

format.description: Be aware that the value of this property includes the degrees of the latitude and must indicate whether it is in the north or south.

family.name: IptcExt-PersonShown
family.label: IPTC Extension: Person Shown in the Image
family.description:
The IPTC Photo Metadata Standard is the most widely used standard to describe photos, because of its universal acceptance among news agencies, photographers, photo agencies, libraries, museums, and other related industries. It structures and defines metadata properties that allow users to add precise and reliable data about images.
Today, the IPTC Photo Metadata Standard consists of two schemas – IPTC Core and IPTC Extension – which were built on the legacy of the original IPTC-IIM, and developed by the IPTC for professional use with a focus on news and stock photos. IPTC worked alongside Adobe on the technical implementation of the metadata that employs Adobe’s XMP technology (now an ISO Standard) as an enriched alternative to the IIM format.
IPTC Core and IPTC Extension define metadata properties with comprehensive sets of fields that allow users to add precise and reliable data about people, locations, and products shown in an image. It also supports dates, names and identifiers regarding the creation of the photo, and a flexible way to express rights information.

tag.name: PersonInImageId
tag.label: Identifier
tag.description: Details about person(s) shown in the image. Globally Unique Identifier of the person.

format.description: Enter globally unique identifier(s) for the person, such as those from WikiData or Freebase. This should be an identifier as it is used with semantic web technology.

tag.name: PersonInImageName
tag.label: Name
tag.description: Details about person(s) shown in the image. Name of the person.

tag.name: PersonInImageDescription
tag.label: Description
tag.description:
Details about person(s) shown in the image. A textual description of the person.
Describes the person, any actions taken, emotional expressions shown, etc. as free-text

tag.name: PersonInImageCvTermCvId
tag.label: CV ID
tag.description: Details about person(s) shown in the image. A property or trait of the person. The globally unique identifier of the Controlled Vocabulary the term is from.

tag.name: PersonInImageCvTermId
tag.label: Term ID
tag.description: Details about person(s) shown in the image. A property or trait of the person. The globally unique identifier of the term from a Controlled Vocabulary.

tag.name: PersonInImageCvTermName
tag.label: Name
tag.description: Details about person(s) shown in the image. A property or trait of the person. The natural language name of the term from a Controlled Vocabulary.

tag.name: PersonInImageCvTermRefinedAbout
tag.label: Refined Aboutness
tag.description: Details about person(s) shown in the image. A property or trait of the person. Optionally enter a refinement of the 'about' relationship of the term with the content of the image. This must be a globally unique identifier from a Controlled Vocabulary

tag.name: ProductInImageGTIN
tag.label: GTIN
tag.description: Details about product shown in the image. A 14 digit GTIN (Global Trade Item Number) of the product (GTIN-8 to GTIN-14 codes are used).
